title: Better educated than ever — yet Germany's Gen Z is being shut out of its own future
summary: Never before have young people around the world been so well-educated while facing so many economic challenges. Young Germans are asking: Will I be better off than my parents?

title: COP31: No agreement on climate science, disinformation spreading
summary: Attacks on climate science and disinformation risk delaying key measures at COP31 in Antalya. As the UN climate talks draw to a close, how will that affect efforts to come to an agreement?

title: EU and UK strike 'landmark deal' to strengthen ties after Brexit
summary: The European Union and the United Kingdom have agreed on "landmark" deals on youth mobility and trade. Leaders on both sides praised the agreement as they seek to rebuild ties.

title: FIFA presidential election 2027: Infantino facing Diallo and Tashima — could an alliance change everything?
summary: Two challengers to Gianni Infantino have registered for next year's FIFA presidential election. What do Philippe Diallo and Kozo Tashima stand for – and do they stand a chance against the incumbent?

title: Germany face Belgium in Nations League quarterfinals — Klopp plays down favorites tag
summary: Germany coach Jürgen Klopp is looking to "carry positive momentum forward" as his team draw neighboring Belgium in the quarterfinals of the UEFA Nations League.

title: Has the 'Parthenon puzzle' been solved? The long quest to reassemble lost eastern pediment
summary: The depiction of the birth of the goddess Athena above the Parthenon's entrance is considered a masterpiece of ancient art. Now, a German research team has pieced together all the surviving fragments.

title: Have we missed our chance to stop climate change?
summary: From record-breaking heat to devastating floods and wildfires, the warning signs are everywhere. Can rising temperatures still be brought under control?

title: Lufthansa to cut 1,000 jobs, citing ongoing losses — reports
summary: According to a letter obtained by the media, Lufthansa's executive board said the German company is losing €20 million every month. In addition to job cuts, operational cuts are also planned.

title: Measles in America: Here's a constructive approach to beating the disease, based on Brazil's experience
summary: The US is now officially a measles contagion zone. By mid-2026, there were more infections than in all of the previous year. But the country could beat measles again, just like Brazil did two years ago.

title: Russian ornithologist jailed over small donations to Navalny's foundation
summary: Sofia Rosenfeld has devoted her life to studying Arctic birds. A Russian court sentenced her to 3.5 years in a penal colony over donations to Navalny's foundation. Friends and family are fighting for her release.

title: Turkey takes control of opposition broadcaster Sozcu TV
summary: In the latest in a series of raids and arrests, another major pro-opposition Turkish broadcaster has been brought under state control. This is the third in a year.
